## Goal

Close the epic-level **outcome** acceptance criterion for LP-0MV8805WF007LTZA: prove that the combined capture-side routing changes raise genuine local busy time above the 36.5% baseline over a comparable 24h window — or record the evidence that mandates a revert.

## Context (from parent LP-0MV8805WF007LTZA)

The four serial stage changes (queue → lease → thresholds → cheap slots) each raise capture along a different axis. This item is the **cumulative** successor to the four per-stage evaluations and is the final keep/revert gate for the epic.

Baseline (2026-10-14 14:39 → 2026-10-15 14:39 window): busy **36.5%**, total compute 12h 07m (50.4% ceiling), capture **14.5%**, packing loss 13.9 pts (avg concurrency 1.38).

## Method

1. Run the canonical analysis over a comparable 24h window after all retained stage changes are live:
   `python3 .pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py --log-dir /var/log/llama-proxy --hours 24`
2. Report, split Total/Fast/Cheap: local busy %; total compute (hours) and the implied ceiling; local capture rate; packing loss; fallback-reason counts.
3. State whether busy time rose above 36.5% and attribute the delta across the four stages (or record that the contributions are not separable at the aggregate level).
4. If busy time did **not** rise, or a guardrail regressed, record the revert decision and the evidence that mandates it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Local busy time (from `proxy-usage-analysis`) is measurably higher than the 36.5% baseline across a comparable 24h window, or the experiment is reverted with recorded evidence.
- [ ] The cumulative keep/revert decision is recorded on this item and fed back to the parent epic LP-0MV8805WF007LTZA.

## Dependencies

- Depends on LP-0MV881PD50056I57, LP-0MV881PO8003QAAF, LP-0MV881PZ60030QN3 and LP-0MV881QA2005MOON — it is the aggregate of the four per-stage evaluations and must run after all of them.

## Notes

- This is an analysis-only item: no proxy config changes here.

## Goal

Ensure every stage of the epic records its **before/after metrics, the log evidence, and an explicit keep/revert decision**, so the four-stage experiment is auditable end-to-end.

## Context (from parent LP-0MV8805WF007LTZA)

Each config change (queue, lease, thresholds, cheap slots) is followed by its own evaluate item. The per-stage evaluations record their own verdicts; this item guarantees the **register** of those records is complete and consistent, and that no stage is left with an unrecorded decision.

## Method

1. Maintain a single evidence register (a comment thread on the parent epic, or a table in the parent description) with one row per stage: stage id, change, before → after metric, evidence artifact (report path / log grep), and keep/revert decision.
2. After each evaluate item completes, append its row and confirm the three required elements are present: before/after metric value, log/report evidence link, explicit decision.
3. Flag any stage whose evaluate item lacks a decision and chase it to a recorded outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each stage records its before/after metrics, the log evidence, and an explicit keep/revert decision.
- [ ] The register lists all four stages (LP-0MV881PD50056I57, LP-0MV881PO8003QAAF, LP-0MV881PZ60030QN3, LP-0MV881QA2005MOON) with no missing rows or decisions.

## Dependencies

- Depends on LP-0MV881PD50056I57, LP-0MV881PO8003QAAF, LP-0MV881PZ60030QN3 and LP-0MV881QA2005MOON — it consumes their verdicts.

## Notes

- Process/evidence item: no proxy config changes here.

data.description:
## Goal

Guarantee traceability for every accepted config change: the commit that lands it references the owning work item and the commit hash is recorded on the items.

## Context (from parent LP-0MV8805WF007LTZA)

Four child items change proxy config: LP-0MV881O5C007PSL4 (queue), LP-0MV881OG4003YMM3 (lease), LP-0MV881OR2002F26W (thresholds), LP-0MV881P24002187Y (cheap slots). Each must land with a traceable commit so the experiment can be audited and reverted.

## Method

1. For each accepted change, confirm the commit message references the work-item id (e.g. `LP-0MV881O5C007PSL4: fast queue depth 3->8 / wait 45s->120s`).
2. Record the commit hash and message in a comment on the owning child item, and add the hash to the parent epic's plan changelog.
3. If a change is reverted, record the revert commit hash the same way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Any accepted config change is committed with the work-item reference and the commit hash recorded on the item.
- [ ] Every accepted change across LP-0MV881O5C007PSL4, LP-0MV881OG4003YMM3, LP-0MV881OR2002F26W and LP-0MV881P24002187Y has a recorded commit hash (or a recorded revert).

## Dependencies

- Depends on LP-0MV881O5C007PSL4, LP-0MV881OG4003YMM3, LP-0MV881OR2002F26W and LP-0MV881P24002187Y — it audits their commits.

## Notes

- Process/traceability item: no proxy config changes here.
